name: Grimdark cosmic horror LLM world sim

mentions.name: Grimdark cosmic horror LLM world sim
mentions.description: An LLM-agent world simulation similar to a MUD-style sim, but set in a grimdark/cosmic horror setting. It layers on Dwarf Fortress/RimWorld-like systems where random events and systems influencing systems keep the agents varied.
mentions.problem: Agents were getting stuck in a loop; adding Dwarf Fortress/RimWorld-like random events and systems influencing systems worked to fix it.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been messing around with a similar project (but in a grimdark/cosmic horror setting). I was running into the same issue, agents getting stuck in a loop. What worked for me was adding dwarf fortress/rimworld like systems. The random events and systems influencing systems worked wonders for me.
